constraints: This is a bounded proposal-only generation task: no experiments, implementations, research status changes, or claim of proven novelty.
Read every assigned goal and question source, plus nearest internal proposal mechanisms and their corrections. Attaching goal IDs without a concrete applicability statement does not cover them.

Use search_knowledge if exposed. It is unavailable in current tool inventory, so use direct committed source reading and primary web retrieval; disclose this retrieval limitation. Absence of search matches cannot establish novelty.

Each idea must have a specific nearest internal record and exact mechanism-level difference; search full existing proposal portfolio including Sept5 and Sept6 bundles. Reparameterization, renamed controls, or a different curve name do not count as a new idea.

Search recent primary literature for mathematical ingredients. Record per-source provenance recalled/retrieved/kb/internal, precise claim, URL or path, and verifying task. Do not convert a remembered source into support.
All ideas stay status proposed and novelty_status unverified. Explain proposed originality as a falsifiable distinction, never a global novelty verdict.

Require exact claim, mechanism, assumptions, observable predictions with numeric threshold or symbolic scaling, minimal discriminating test, matched null, known-false control, confounders, falsification and scope. Tests are designs only.

Every idea gives time, memory and data/query cost expressions including setup, transport, preprocessing, sample acquisition, linear algebra and verification when applicable. If no exponent improvement is claimed, explicitly state target improvement metric and zero established exponent gain.

dominated_by must not be null unless every row of the declared relevant frontier was checked in time,memory,data/query dimensions. An unresolved comparison is a literal unresolved object with named missing comparisons. sota_delta is quantitative conditional arithmetic or exact zero established improvement, with assumptions; do not invent measurements.

For each proof-oriented proposal supply a complete proof_search_map: bottleneck, exact baseline slice, observation collision search design, constructive transform, quantifier order, method ceiling/nearby object control and separate correctness/runtime/success/interface obligations. Named heuristics each have a falsification condition and validation route.
Follow the representation-operation pair discipline in docs/object-frame-ideation.md and agents/idea-generator.md; price orbit canonicalization or branching and retained information.

Keep terminal goals as historical context and add contextual_goal_ids where applicable; do not reopen or attach them as active task owners. Preserve literal rank>=32 over Q and rank31 field-degree<16 criteria.
Shared SafeCurves mechanisms count once, with per-curve applicability and explicit anomalous-curve treatment. Do not pad twenty curve copies.

At least fourteen of your twenty proposals should be mechanisms, algorithms, representations or compositions; measurement/control ideas must expose a named mathematical uncertainty and a decision-changing threshold.

Write one complete idea body per allocated ID under ideas:[...]. Required fields: id,title,class,claim,mechanism,question_id,question_ids,goal_ids,goal_applicability,status,proposed_by,recorded_at,task_id,batch_id,novelty_status,novelty_screen,citations,assumptions,predictions,minimal_test,falsification_conditions,confounders,interpretation_limits,heuristic_assumptions,target_complexity,estimated_cost,recommended_priority,proof_search_map,dominated_by,sota_delta,inference.
No sibling producer or reviewer outputs. Write only your three declared paths; no ledger writes or commits. You are not alone in the checkout; preserve others edits.

Use only actual native runtime model provenance. Requested research-deep high policy is separate from actual gpt-6-astra native identity; model_verified:false absent API probe, native authentication checked by control plane. Never Bedrock.
If any slot remains duplicate or underspecified, revise it before completion or report the exact gap. Never invent novelty or cheap cost to fill a quota.
